description: Send a short message to another named agent session, by agent_session_id, unique subject, or the id of the conversation that dispatched you. A live target receives it at its next tool boundary; a resident idle target wakes; a parked target gets a pending inbox record (agent_out mode=inbox). The message arrives inside an <agent_message> envelope whose reply_to attribute is the id to pass back when you answer. Named targets accept their owner, a sibling under the same parent, or their own child; a main conversation accepts only a named child it dispatched, and only while it is live. Use only for coordination among named sessions; the main conversation receives your final report, not a message.
name: agent_message

content.description: Message text; brief coordination, not a long report.

progress.description: Mark this as a progress note; the final answer follows later.

reply_to.description: The inbound envelope's reply_to value when this message answers one; omitted for a new thread.

to.description: Target agent_session_id, profile-unique short name, a unique subject, or the id of the owning conversation (a named child may message its owner).
